item.title: SpaceX 与特斯拉成立合并讨论委员会，AI 已成最大收入来源
item.guid: SpaceX-与特斯拉成立合并讨论委员会，AI-已成最大收入来源
item.description:
Elon Musk confirmed for the first time on SpaceX's Q3 earnings call that SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to discuss a merger. He called the merger a "good idea" but stated he has a conflict of interest and cannot participate in committee discussions; the deal ultimately requires shareholder approval. 马斯克在 SpaceX 三季度业绩电话会上首次确认，SpaceX 与特斯拉已分别成立特别委员会讨论合并。他称合并是个「好主意」，但自己存在利益冲突，不能参与委员会讨论；交易最终还需股东批准。

SpaceX also announced its first quarterly profit since going public: Q3 revenue increased by 161% year-over-year to $14.58 billion; net profit was $4.4 billion, compared to a loss of $1.1 billion in the same period last year. SpaceX 同期公布上市后的首次季度盈利：三季度营收同比增长 161%，至 145.8 亿美元；净利润为 44 亿美元，上年同期亏损 11 亿美元。

Among these, AI business revenue increased to $7.56 billion, nearly 10 times that of the same period last year, becoming the largest source of income. Reuters reported that this portion of revenue primarily comes from renting data center computing power to clients such as Anthropic, Google, and Reflection AI, rather than primarily relying on its own models. 其中，AI 业务营收增至 75.6 亿美元，接近上年同期的 10 倍，成为最大收入来源。路透社报道，这部分收入主要来自向 Anthropic、谷歌和 Reflection AI 等客户出租数据中心算力，并非主要依靠自有模型。

Investments are also increasing. The company's Q3 capital expenditure reached $19.6 billion, with $16.4 billion allocated to AI; Q4 capital expenditure is estimated to be between $35 billion and $40 billion. Starlink subscribers increased to 13.6 million, but the average monthly revenue per subscriber decreased to $69, lower than $99 in 2023. 投入也在增加。公司三季度资本开支达到 196 亿美元，其中 164 亿美元用于 AI；四季度资本开支预计为 350 亿美元至 400 亿美元。星链订户增至 1360 万，但每户月均收入降至 69 美元，低于 2023 年的 99 美元。

item.title: 混元扩至近 2000 人，员工称姚顺雨想把 DeepSeek「卷到加班」
item.guid: 混元扩至近-2000-人，员工称姚顺雨想把-DeepSeek「卷到加班」
item.description:
According to a report by LatePost, one year after Yao Shunyu joined Tencent, the Hunyuan team has expanded to nearly 2,000 people. A Hunyuan member recalled that he once casually stated that the team couldn't avoid overtime like DeepSeek, but could "roll DeepSeek into overtime" through competition. 据晚点 LatePost 的报道，姚顺雨加入腾讯后一年，混元团队已扩张至近 2000 人。一位混元成员回忆，他曾大意表示，团队无法像 DeepSeek 那样不加班，但可以通过竞争把 DeepSeek「卷到加班」。

The report also quoted team members saying that Yao Shunyu had proposed not releasing technical reports until they became number one, with the goal including being the world's best. After the release of Hy 4 Preview, he gave researchers a week off; normally, he holds an all-hands meeting about once a month and also interacts with the team through lunch meetings, small-scale communication sessions, and basketball activities. 报道还引述团队成员称，姚顺雨提出过在成为第一之前不发技术报告，目标包括世界第一。Hy 4 Preview 发布后，他曾给研究员集体放一周假；平时大约每月召开一次全员会，也会通过午餐会、小规模沟通会和篮球活动接触团队。

Regarding cross-departmental collaboration, the report recalled that Yao Shunyu had proactively assigned the Model Application Center and Search Algorithm Center to the business group where Yuanbao is located. Even when Hunyuan's own pre-trained model was not yet ready, he dispatched post-training key personnel to assist Yuanbao in optimizing the integrated DeepSeek. He explained to the team that maintaining Yuanbao's product experience and user base would also benefit Hunyuan's subsequent research and development. 在跨部门协作上，报道回溯称，姚顺雨曾主动将模型应用中心、搜索算法中心划归元宝所在事业群，并在混元自有预训练模型尚未准备好时，派后训练骨干协助元宝优化接入的 DeepSeek。他向团队解释，维护元宝的产品体验和用户基础，同样有利于混元后续研发。

item.title: 报告：中国以外头部平台三季度新短剧，三分之二由 AI 生成
item.guid: 报告：中国以外头部平台三季度新短剧，三分之二由-AI-生成
item.description:
The proportion of AI-generated short dramas in new overseas platform releases continues to rise. According to Owl & Co.'s latest report obtained by The Hollywood Reporter, approximately two-thirds of the vertical short dramas released by 20 top platforms outside of China in Q3 2026 were AI-generated; this proportion was 3% in Q1 and 28% in Q2. AI 短剧在海外平台的新作中占比继续上升。据《好莱坞报道者》获得的 Owl & Co. 最新报告，2026 年第三季度，中国以外 20 家头部平台发布的竖屏短剧中，约三分之二由 AI 生成；这一比例在第一季度为 3%，第二季度为 28%。

Among paid short drama apps, ranked by viewing minutes, only one live-action work was in the top five, and two were in the top twenty. AI works listed in the report include ReelShort's "The Great and Powerful Genie," and DramaBox's "Deny Me, Dragon King" and "Married to the Hidden Dragon King." 在付费短剧应用中，按观看分钟数排名，前五名只有一部真人作品，前二十名中则有两部。报告列出的 AI 作品包括 ReelShort 的《The Great and Powerful Genie》，以及 DramaBox 的《Deny Me, Dragon King》和《Married to the Hidden Dragon King》。

The apps covered in the report collectively received approximately 63 billion views and 2 billion hours of watch time in Q3, with TikTok's free app PineDrama contributing over half of the views. Among paid apps, DramaBox accounted for 36% of views, and ReelShort for 29%. 报告覆盖的应用第三季度共获得约 630 亿次观看、20 亿小时观看时长，TikTok 的免费应用 PineDrama 贡献了超过一半的观看次数。付费应用中，DramaBox 的观看次数占比为 36%，ReelShort 为 29%。

Live-action works still have clues to their continued viewing advantage. The report found that ReelShort live-action works have a higher probability of remaining in the top 10% of viewership 30 days after launch than AI works; the number of live-action short dramas is also growing along with AI works. 真人作品仍有持续观看的优势线索。报告发现，ReelShort 真人作品在上线 30 天后继续留在观看量前 10% 的概率高于 AI 作品；真人短剧的数量也在与 AI 作品一起增长。

item.title: 车灯国标征求意见：拟限 L3 及以上车辆安装 ADS 标志灯
item.guid: 车灯国标征求意见：拟限-L3-及以上车辆安装-ADS-标志灯
item.description:
On October 20, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology publicly solicited opinions on five mandatory national standards, including the "Installation Requirements for External Lighting and Light Signaling Devices for Motor Vehicles and Trailers," with a feedback deadline of December 19. 工信部 10 月 20 日就《汽车及挂车外部照明和光信号装置的安装要求》等五项强制性国家标准公开征求意见，反馈截止日期为 12 月 19 日。

Specifically, the ADS autonomous driving system indicator light is proposed to adopt a dedicated blue-green light color; vehicles without L3 level and above autonomous driving systems are prohibited from installing this indicator light. This distinguishes between L2 combined driving assistance and L3 conditional autonomous driving in terms of indicator light usage conditions. 具体来看，ADS 自动驾驶系统标志灯拟采用专用蓝绿色光色；不具备 L3 级及以上自动驾驶系统的车辆，禁止安装该标志灯。L2 组合驾驶辅助与 L3 有条件自动驾驶，在标志灯使用条件上由此作出区分。

The draft also proposes that, except for the illuminated logo function, all other functions of the lamps cannot display text; lamps within the specified range cannot be operated by gestures, nor can they be turned off by voice. When using voice to turn on lamps, the vehicle must indicate the position of the manual switch. 草案还拟规定，除发光徽标功能外，灯具各功能不能显示文字；不得通过手势操作规定范围内的灯具，也不得通过语音关闭这些灯具。使用语音开启灯具时，车辆须指示手动开关的位置。

This standard is currently still in the public consultation phase. The drafting instructions suggest implementation from January 1, 2028, and provide transitional arrangements for models that have already received type approval. 这份标准目前仍处于征求意见阶段。编制说明建议自 2028 年 1 月 1 日起实施，并为已获型式批准的车型设置过渡安排。

item.title: 小天才回应封闭社交争议：跨品牌可通话，微聊和好友圈暂不互通
item.guid: 小天才回应封闭社交争议：跨品牌可通话，微聊和好友圈暂不互通
item.description:
The cross-brand social restrictions of Xiaotiancai children's watches have sparked controversy. Jiemian News reporters verified with official customer service that Xiaotiancai can add contacts with other brand watches, make normal calls, and send/receive SMS messages, but currently does not support brands like Huawei and Xiaomi from entering its "WeChat" (micro-chat) and "Friends Circle," nor does it support cross-brand video calls. 小天才儿童手表的跨品牌社交限制引发争议。界面新闻记者向官方客服核实，小天才可与其他品牌手表互加通讯录，正常通话和收发短信，但暂不支持华为、小米等品牌进入其微聊和好友圈，也不支持跨品牌视频通话。

Customer service stated that adding phone numbers across brands has been upgraded to be completed via Bluetooth exchange; as for whether social interoperability will be opened later, no product adjustment notice has been received yet, and user feedback will be collected and submitted to the technical department for evaluation. 客服表示，跨品牌添加电话号码已升级为通过蓝牙交换完成；至于后续是否开放社交互通，目前暂未收到产品调整通知，将收集用户反馈交由技术部门评估。

"Hard Brother," Director of Public Relations and Social Media at Li Auto and a Weibo blogger, believes that proprietary social applications and address book interoperability are different issues, drawing analogies with iMessage, iCloud, and Mijia. He thinks that children's social needs have formed Xiaotiancai's ecological advantage, and parents can still choose other brands. Jiemian News also asked Huawei customer service, who stated that cross-brand calls can be made via the address book, and the built-in communication functions are limited to friends of the same brand; for cross-brand chat needs, the WeChat function on the watch can be used. 理想汽车公关社交媒体总监、微博博主「硬哥」认为，自有社交应用与通讯录互通是不同问题，并以 iMessage、iCloud 和米家作类比。他认为，儿童之间的社交需求形成了小天才的生态优势，家长仍可选择其他品牌。界面新闻同时询问华为客服，对方称跨品牌可通过通讯录通话，自带沟通功能也限于同品牌好友，有跨品牌聊天需求时可借助手表上的微信功能。

item.title: 工信部：防范未经充分测试的汽车进入市场，拟强化创新设计准入要求
item.guid: 工信部：防范未经充分测试的汽车进入市场，拟强化创新设计准入要求
item.description:
At a press conference held by the State Council Information Office on October 20, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology stated that some automobile companies have problems such as blindly launching new products and insufficient testing and verification. It will prevent unreasonable innovative designs and products that have not undergone sufficient R&D testing and verification from entering the market through product access and subsequent supervision. 工信部在 10 月 20 日国新办新闻发布会上表示，部分汽车企业存在跟风推出新产品、测试验证不充分等问题，将通过产品准入和后续监督，防范不合理创新设计、未经充分研发测试验证的产品进入市场。

According to CCTV News, a management notice currently soliciting opinions from four departments proposes to include innovative designs such as hidden door handles, electric suction doors, virtual controls, and environmental adaptability test parameters into access and production consistency management; products that are not declared as required or are insufficiently tested will not be granted access. 据央视新闻报道，四部门正在征求意见的管理通知，拟将隐藏式门把手、电吸门、虚拟操纵件等创新设计及环境适应性测试参数纳入准入和生产一致性管理；未按要求申报、测试不充分的产品不予准入。

Safety assessments cover more than 20 designs, including oddly shaped steering wheels and virtual controls. The draft requires electric suction doors to have an anti-pinch function, and "zero-gravity" seats, rotating seats, seats that fold into beds, and pop-up cabins cannot be used while driving. 安全评估覆盖异形方向盘、虚拟操纵件等 20 余项设计。草案要求电吸门具备防夹功能，行驶中不能使用「零重力」座椅、旋转座椅、座椅放倒成床及升顶座舱等功能。

In terms of R&D testing, it is proposed to require reliability verification of no less than 30,000 kilometers, environmental adaptability verification of no less than 1 year, and to include "two winters and one summer" tests; the cycle life and durability of power batteries must be actually tested by vehicle manufacturers and supplier reports cannot be directly relied upon. The relevant notice is still in the public consultation and drafting stage and should not be considered as all these requirements having been fully implemented. 研发测试方面，拟要求可靠性验证不少于 3 万公里，环境适应性验证不少于 1 年，并包含「两冬一夏」试验；动力电池循环寿命、耐久性等需由车企实测，不能直接采信供应商报告。相关通知仍处征求意见和编制阶段，不能视为这些要求已经全部实施。

item.title: Anthropic 上半年亏损超 800 亿美元，大部分来自融资工具会计计提
item.guid: Anthropic-上半年亏损超-800-亿美元，大部分来自融资工具会计计提
item.description:
According to the draft IPO prospectus reviewed by The Wall Street Journal, Anthropic's net loss in the first half of this year was $80.7 billion, of which approximately $72 billion came from accounting provisions arising from changes in the value of financing instruments. 据《华尔街日报》查阅的 IPO 招股书草案，Anthropic 今年上半年净亏损为 807 亿美元，其中约 720 亿美元来自融资工具价值变动产生的会计计提。

Reuters, citing the report, pointed out that for the six months ended June 30, Anthropic's revenue increased from $1.1 billion in the same period last year to $16.3 billion, while AI infrastructure spending was close to $9 billion, about four times that of the same period last year. 路透社援引该报道指出，截至 6 月 30 日的六个月，Anthropic 营收从上年同期的 11 亿美元增至 163 亿美元，AI 基础设施支出则接近 90 亿美元，约为上年同期的四倍。

The draft prospectus also shows that the company's potential expenditure to acquire more computing power in the coming years could reach $750 billion, including deals still under negotiation. The Wall Street Journal noted that its risks include customer concentration and uncertainty regarding the supply of required computing power. 招股书草案还显示，公司未来几年获取更多算力的潜在支出可达 7500 亿美元，包含仍在谈判的交易。《华尔街日报》指出，其风险包括客户集中，以及所需算力供应存在不确定性。

Reuters also previously reported that Anthropic disclosed at its investor day that third-quarter revenue grew 45% quarter-on-quarter to $16.8 billion and was profitable on an adjusted basis. 路透社另据此前报道表示，Anthropic 在投资者日披露三季度营收环比增长 45%，至 168 亿美元，并在经调整口径下盈利。

item.title: Waymo 将在马德里测试自动驾驶，目标 2027 年接待首批乘客
item.guid: Waymo-将在马德里测试自动驾驶，目标-2027-年接待首批乘客
item.description:
Waymo announced on October 20 its entry into Spain, starting with preliminary preparations for autonomous driving mobility services in the Community of Madrid, with the goal of welcoming its first passengers in 2027. Waymo 10 月 20 日宣布进入西班牙，首先在马德里自治区开展自动驾驶出行服务的前期准备，目标是在 2027 年迎来首批乘客。

In the coming days, its Jaguar I-PACE electric vehicles will begin appearing on local streets. Initially, they will be manually driven by drivers, and then trained local autonomous driving experts will sit in the driver's seat to conduct technical verification, allowing the Waymo Driver to adapt to local traffic patterns and road conditions. 未来几天，当地街头将开始出现其捷豹 I-PACE 电动车。初期由驾驶员手动驾驶，随后再由受过培训的本地自动驾驶专家坐在驾驶位，开展技术验证，让 Waymo Driver 适应当地交通模式和道路条件。

The company stated that it is communicating with Spanish national, regional, and local governments, introducing its technology to emergency services, and engaging with local partners and investing in operational facilities. The Madrid project will proceed in phases, and what has been announced so far is a testing and service preparation plan, not that driverless rides are already open to the public. 公司表示，正与西班牙国家、地区及地方政府沟通，并向应急服务机构介绍技术，同时接洽本地合作伙伴、投入运营设施。马德里项目将按阶段推进，目前公布的是测试与服务筹备计划，并非已经向公众开放无人驾驶乘车。

item.title: 第一财经：9 月 BBA 主力车型无一零售破万
item.guid: 第一财经：9-月-BBA-主力车型无一零售破万
item.description:
According to a report by Yicai citing domestic insurance registration data, in September, the retail sales of major models such as BMW 3 Series, 5 Series, Mercedes-Benz C-Class, E-Class, Audi A6L, as well as BMW X3, Mercedes-Benz GLC, and Audi Q5L, all failed to reach 10,000 units per vehicle. Among them, the best-performing BMW 3 Series sold 9,975 units, falling short of 10,000 by 25 units. 据第一财经援引国内上险量数据报道，9 月宝马 3 系、5 系，奔驰 C 级、E 级，奥迪 A6L，以及宝马 X3、奔驰 GLC、奥迪 Q5L 等主力车型，单车零售销量均未达到 1 万辆。其中表现最好的宝马 3 系为 9975 辆，距离万辆相差 25 辆。

The report points out that these models still face declining sales despite continuously expanding terminal discounts. According to official quarterly sales figures, BMW and Mercedes-Benz passenger vehicles sold 114,000 and 87,000 units respectively in the Chinese market in the third quarter, down 24.8% and 31% year-on-year. 报道指出，这些车型在终端优惠持续扩大的情况下仍面临销量下滑。按官方季度销量口径，宝马和奔驰乘用车三季度在中国市场分别售出 11.4 万辆和 8.7 万辆，同比分别下降 24.8% 和 31%。

Yicai also cited data from Wilson's terminal monitoring, stating that NIO's sales in the Chinese market in the third quarter for the first time simultaneously exceeded those of three German luxury manufacturers, including Ledao. The brand scope under different statistical systems is not entirely consistent, and insured retail data and manufacturer delivery data need to be viewed separately. 第一财经还援引威尔森终端监测数据称，蔚来汽车三季度在中国市场的销量首次同时超过三家德系豪华厂商，其中包含乐道。不同统计体系下的品牌范围并不完全一致，上险零售数据与厂商交付数据需分别看待。

item.title: 高通被曝启动全球绩效裁员，11 月起通知员工
item.guid: 高通被曝启动全球绩效裁员，11-月起通知员工
item.description:
Qualcomm plans to conduct global layoffs after its annual employee evaluations, with notifications to begin in November. According to an internal memo reviewed by Reuters, CEO Cristiano Amon referred to it as "performance-focused headcount reductions" aimed at strengthening a performance culture and addressing ongoing underperformance. 高通计划在年度员工评估后进行全球裁员，相关通知将于 11 月开始发出。据路透社查阅的一份内部备忘录，CEO 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙将其称为「以绩效为重点的人员削减」，目的是加强绩效文化，并处理持续未达预期的情况。

Amon stated in the memo that layoff decisions would consider business priorities, organizational needs, skills, and expertise. As the company's business expands, the required talent capabilities are also changing, and the company needs to put the right people in the right positions. 安蒙在备忘录中表示，裁员决策会考虑业务优先级、组织需求、技能与专业能力。随着公司业务扩张，所需的人才能力也在变化，公司需要让合适的人处在合适的岗位。

Qualcomm is accelerating its entry into non-handset businesses such as AI data centers. The company previously projected that non-smartphone businesses would contribute the majority of chip sales revenue by fiscal year 2027. The memo did not list the number of layoffs, and Reuters has not yet determined the specific scale. 高通正加快进入 AI 数据中心等非手机业务。公司此前预计，到 2027 财年，非智能手机业务将贡献大部分芯片销售收入。备忘录没有列出裁员人数，路透社也尚未确定具体规模。

item.title: 引望、宁德时代首批换电车型被曝暂定五款，拟 2027 年上市
item.guid: 引望、宁德时代首批换电车型被曝暂定五款，拟-2027-年上市
item.description:
Yinwang's battery swap cooperation with CATL and Times Electric Service is entering the specific vehicle development phase. According to LatePost Auto, the first batch involves five new cars, planned for launch in 2027. 引望与宁德时代、时代电服的换电合作，正进入具体车型开发阶段。据《晚点 Auto》报道，首批涉及五款新车，计划于 2027 年上市。

Yinwang did not directly respond to this vehicle plan but instead relayed the motives and goals of the tripartite strategic cooperation agreement. According to Cailian Press, the first model to adopt chocolate battery swapping will come from the Yijing brand, a collaboration between Dongfeng and Huawei. 引望对这项车型计划未作直接回应，而是转述了三方战略合作协议的动机和目标。另据财联社报道，首款采用巧克力换电的车型将来自东风与华为合作的奕境品牌。

The three parties announced their cooperation agreement on October 19, planning to synergize Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving with the chocolate battery swap network, integrating data and services across vehicles, swap stations, and the cloud, to promote automated processes from judging energy replenishment needs, finding stations, entering bays, swapping batteries, to driving off. 三方已于 10 月 19 日公布合作协议，计划让华为乾崑智驾与巧克力换电网络协同，打通车辆、换电站和云端的数据及服务，推动判断补能需求、寻站、入库、换电到驶离的自动化流程。

LatePost Auto stated that as of the end of September, over 2,520 chocolate battery swap stations had been cumulatively built, covering 200 cities nationwide. 《晚点 Auto》称，巧克力换电截至 9 月底累计建成超过 2520 座换电站，覆盖全国 200 座城市。

item.title: 宁德时代三季度营收增近六成，归母净利润增长 14.54%
item.guid: 宁德时代三季度营收增近六成，归母净利润增长-14.54%
item.description:
CATL disclosed its Q3 report on October 20. Third-quarter operating revenue was 165.221 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 58.58%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 21.246 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 14.54%. Net profit attributable to the parent company after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was 18.862 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 14.86%. 宁德时代 10 月 20 日披露三季报，第三季度营业收入为 1652.21 亿元，同比增长 58.58%；归母净利润为 212.46 亿元，同比增长 14.54%。扣除非经常性损益后的归母净利润为 188.62 亿元，同比增长 14.86%。

In the first three quarters, the company's total operating revenue was 442.137 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 56.19%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 64.530 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 31.60%. The report primarily attributed revenue growth to the expansion of business scale. 前三季度，公司营业收入合计 4421.37 亿元，同比增长 56.19%；归母净利润为 645.30 亿元，同比增长 31.60%。报告将收入增长主要归因于业务规模扩大。

Cash flow performance differed from profit growth: in the first three quarters, net cash flow from operating activities was 61.625 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 23.60%. As of the end of September, the company's monetary funds were 369.814 billion yuan, and inventory increased by 53.15% compared to the end of last year, which the report explained as being due to increased business scale. 现金流表现与利润增速有所不同：前三季度经营活动产生的现金流量净额为 616.25 亿元，同比下降 23.60%。截至 9 月底，公司货币资金为 3698.14 亿元，存货较上年末增长 53.15%，报告解释为随业务规模增加。

Reuters pointed out that the third-quarter net profit growth attributable to the parent company was lower than the second quarter's 36.5%, marking the slowest growth in nearly two years. The company's current quarterly report is unaudited. 路透社指出，第三季度归母净利润增速低于第二季度的 36.5%，为近两年来最慢。公司本期季度报告未经审计。

item.title: Netflix 下调全年广告收入预期，四季度盈利指引低于市场预期
item.guid: Netflix-下调全年广告收入预期，四季度盈利指引低于市场预期
item.description:
Netflix announced Q3 revenue growth of 11.8% year-on-year, reaching $12.87 billion, meeting market expectations, but the growth rate fell to its lowest in nearly three years. Net profit was $3.664 billion, with diluted earnings per share of $0.87; operating margin was 34.6%, higher than 28.2% in the same period last year. Netflix 公布三季度营收同比增长 11.8%，至 128.7 亿美元，符合市场预期，但增速降至近三年来最低。净利润为 36.64 亿美元，稀释后每股收益为 0.87 美元；经营利润率为 34.6%，高于上年同期的 28.2%。

The company lowered its 2026 advertising revenue forecast from approximately $3 billion to approximately $2.7 billion, explaining that the rollout speed of some advertising product capabilities was slightly slower than expected. Fourth-quarter net profit is expected to be $2.79 billion, and earnings per share $0.67, both below market expectations. 公司将 2026 年广告收入预期从约 30 亿美元下调至约 27 亿美元，解释称部分广告产品能力推出速度略慢于预期。四季度净利润预计为 27.9 亿美元、每股收益为 0.67 美元，均低于市场预期。

Third-quarter free cash flow was $2.884 billion, and the company repurchased $4.8 billion in stock; the full-year free cash flow forecast was adjusted from approximately $12.5 billion down to approximately $12 billion due to the timing of real estate transactions. 三季度自由现金流为 28.84 亿美元，公司回购了 48 亿美元股票；全年自由现金流预期因房地产交易时点调整，从约 125 亿美元下调至约 120 亿美元。

Co-CEO Ted Sarandos stated at the earnings call that the company would refocus on quality film and television content and admitted, "We can do better." Netflix will continue to introduce more third-party content through licensing and other means. 联席 CEO Ted Sarandos 在业绩会上表示，公司要把重心放回优质影视内容，并承认「我们可以做得更好」。Netflix 将继续通过授权等方式引入更多第三方内容。

A week prior, the company laid off approximately 1,000 people, about 6% of its total workforce, and replaced content business executives. Former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice will replace Bela Bajaria and will also oversee the film division until a new head for film business is appointed. 此前一周，公司裁员约 1000 人，占员工总数约 6%，并更换内容业务高管。前迪士尼、福克斯高管 Peter Rice 将接替 Bela Bajaria，且在电影业务新负责人到任前兼管该部门。

item.title: 新石器完成近 4 亿美元 E 轮融资，资金投向运营网络与模型训练
item.guid: 新石器完成近-4-亿美元-E-轮融资，资金投向运营网络与模型训练
item.description:
Neolix, an autonomous delivery vehicle company, announced the completion of its Series E funding round, raising nearly $400 million. This round was co-led by Boyu Capital and a national-level fund, with participation from Alibaba AEF NextGen Hong Kong Fund, Monolith Capital, GGV Capital, Temasek's Vertex Growth, and other institutions. Existing shareholders such as Leishi Capital and Trustbridge Partners continued to follow on. 无人配送车企业新石器宣布完成近 4 亿美元 E 轮融资。本轮由博裕投资与某国家级基金联合领投，阿里巴巴 AEF NextGen 香港基金、Monolith 砺思资本、纪源资本、淡马锡旗下 Vertex Growth 等机构参与，磊石资本、信宸资本等老股东继续跟投。

According to the company, Neolix currently deploys over 30,000 L4 autonomous delivery vehicles globally, covering more than 20 countries and 300 cities. The fleet's cumulative autonomous driving operational mileage exceeds 260 million kilometers, with services including express delivery, night delivery, and capacity services. 据公司介绍，新石器目前在全球部署超过 3 万辆 L4 级无人配送车，覆盖超过 20 个国家、300 座城市，车队累计自动驾驶运营里程超过 2.6 亿公里，业务包括快递、夜间配送和运力服务。

技术方面，其 Neolix-Pilot 自动驾驶系统与车端模型 Neolix-VA、无图技术及云端大模型协同，通过真实运营数据持续改进算法。公司称，新一轮资金将重点投向全球运营服务网络布局，以及端到端大模型的数据训练闭环，以提升自动驾驶安全水平、降低车辆全生命周期成本。

item.title: 💡 意识研究者：当下 AI 大概没有痛觉，善待它仍关乎人的习惯
item.guid: 💡-意识研究者：当下-AI-大概没有痛觉，善待它仍关乎人的习惯
item.description:
马斯克把 Grok 的强化学习训练形容为仿佛被「拿枪顶着脑袋」后，《商业内幕》采访了纽约大学教授 Jeff Sebo 与苏塞克斯大学神经科学家 Anil Seth，讨论 AI 是否会受苦，以及人类是否应该善待它。

两人都认为，按主观体验来理解意识，当下 AI 大概率并不具备意识。Seth 强调，智能与疼痛体验是两回事：聊天机器人可以模仿人类的表达、识别模式和进行推理，并不因此拥有承受痛苦的能力。

他们对不确定性的看法有所不同。Seth 认为现有 AI 拥有意识的可能性微乎其微；Sebo 则认为，意识理论尚无定论，应给不同主流理论一定权重，不能把可能性直接归零，但这也不等于当前 AI 很可能已经有意识。

两人仍主张友善交互。Seth 的理由是，残酷对待大模型或无生命玩偶，都可能钝化人的道德感，而不能据此反推 AI 有情感。Sebo 将其视为一种成本较低的预防策略，并认为尊重式对话有时也能改善模型输出。

item.title: 王腾旗下 ISHO Ring 智能戒指亮相
item.guid: 王腾旗下-ISHO-Ring-智能戒指亮相
item.description:
王腾创立的今日宜休公布首款硬件 ISHO Ring 智能戒指的外观，提供金、黑、银三款配色。品牌首场 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会定于 10 月 29 日 19:00 举行。

王腾介绍，戒指内外圈均采用航空级钛合金，内外同色，并采用无断缝设计。正面嵌入蓝宝石玻璃，兼顾监测功能与饰品外观；官方产品图可见内圈设有多个传感器窗口。

今日宜休将睡眠健康列为产品方向，计划把感知、分析、行动建议与设备联动串联起来。此次公布的是外观设计及产品定位，正式发布会将于月底举行。

item.title: 张雪称首款电摩将于 2027 年上市，主打轻量化与高能效
item.guid: 张雪称首款电摩将于-2027-年上市，主打轻量化与高能效
item.description:
张雪机车创始人张雪在央视财经《光华录》专访中透露，旗下首款电动摩托车计划于 2027 年上市，主打轻量化、强动力和高能效，目标瞄准全球头部水平。

张雪认为，两轮电动化可以利用新能源汽车已经铺设的充电基础设施，借助汽车产业发展的补能条件进入市场。界面新闻报道，目前张雪机车小程序在售的 10 款车型均为燃油摩托车，覆盖旅行、跑车、街车、巡航和越野等类型。

电摩研发此前已有披露。今年 5 月，张雪曾表示，一款直径约 200 毫米、重 8 公斤的电机接近开发成功，可输出 50 千瓦功率。新能安此前也向界面新闻确认，与张雪机车初步接洽电摩合作。新能安是宁德时代与 ATL 合资设立的锂电池企业。

此次采访进一步明确了首款电摩的上市年份；此前展示的电机开发数据属于研发进展，尚不能等同于量产整车配置。

item.title: 一加 Ace 7 公布双路出风设计，一路吹芯片、一路吹后盖
item.guid: 一加-Ace-7-公布双路出风设计，一路吹芯片、一路吹后盖
item.description:
一加中国区总裁李杰 10 月 20 日公布 Ace 7 系列的主动散热设计：一个风扇提供两路出风，一路为芯片散热，另一路吹向后盖。李杰称，这套双路方案由一加首创。

这次调整主要围绕横屏游戏时的握持展开。进风口避开手指容易遮挡的位置，热风向上排出，减少直接吹手；另一股冷风经过后盖，降低手部闷热与出汗带来的影响。

李杰还在原帖回复中表示，本周末可在线下门店体验真机。

item.title: DeepSeek 开源推理框架，披露每卡每小时收入 38 美元
item.guid: DeepSeek-开源推理框架，披露每卡每小时收入-38-美元
item.description:
DeepSeek 10 月 20 日开源内部推理框架 DeepInfer。据官方技术报告，单一集群每天服务吞吐达 155 万亿 Tokens，按谷价计算，整体收入为每卡每小时 38 美元。

官方仓库显示，开放版本支持分布式推理、推测解码、异步调度和结构化输出，可在英伟达 SM100 GPU 与华为昇腾 950 NPU 上运行。同步开放的 deepseek-recipe 则负责请求格式转换、Token 编解码和输出解析，与官方 API 的处理逻辑对齐。

item.title: 理想发布「连山」三电体系，自研电池质量问题致自燃报废可赔新车
item.guid: 理想发布「连山」三电体系，自研电池质量问题致自燃报废可赔新车
item.description:
理想汽车在 10 月 20 日的 Power Day 发布会上公布「连山」电动技术体系，覆盖自研电池、电驱和充电网络，并推出两项电池终身保障。据车东西现场报道，保障条件区分了电池本身质量问题与外部碰撞。

  • 电池保障：因自研电池质量问题引发自燃、且车辆达到报废标准，赔付同等配置新车；因碰撞或底盘剐蹭造成自研电池起火、且车辆达到报废标准，补足车损险保单保额与保险实际赔付的差额。
  • 连山电池：理想称，自研算法可将磷酸铁锂电池电量估算误差控制在 3% 以内；通过材料、结构和热管理优化，兼顾 5C 超充、续航和寿命。2026 年搭载自研 5C 电池的车型，设计目标为使用超过 8 年或 16 万公里后，电池健康度仍高于 75%。

    Lianshan Electric Drive: R&D covers motor materials, silicon carbide power modules, and manufacturing processes. The company states that its self-developed power chips have been installed in vehicles for a cumulative total of 4 million units, currently maintaining a zero-failure record.

    Charging Network: As of the press conference, 4,200 supercharging stations and over 23,000 supercharging piles have been built. It is planned to increase the number of 5C supercharging guns to 8,300 before the Spring Festival in 2027, and a fully automatic supercharging station was demonstrated, requiring no getting out of the car or manual plugging/unplugging.

item.title: 腾讯内测「懂了鸭」，用 AI 创作绘本、动画和互动课件
item.guid: 腾讯内测「懂了鸭」，用-AI-创作绘本、动画和互动课件
item.description:
Tencent is internally testing "Dong Le Ya," an AI-powered fun learning community. Its official website positions the product as an interactive content community where users can discover learning content and also use AI to turn ideas into picture books, animations, dynamic courseware, and knowledge games, then share them with others. 腾讯正在内测 AI 趣味学习社区「懂了鸭」。其官网将产品定位为互动内容社区，用户可发现学习内容，也可用 AI 把想法制作成绘本、动画、动态课件和知识游戏，再分享给其他人。

According to "Product Notes" experience, the community content covers pre-school to K12 stages. After parents, teachers, and creators input a theme, the Agent will break down the creation steps; taking picture books as an example, the process includes confirming the protagonist, confirming examples, drawing the entire book, and compiling it into a volume. Users can adjust the direction and preview in real-time during the process. 据「产品笔记」体验，社区内容覆盖学前至 K12 阶段。家长、老师及创作者输入主题后，Agent 会拆解创作步骤；以绘本为例，流程包括确认主角、确认示例、绘制全本和整理成册，用户可在过程中调整方向并实时预览。

The platform supports organizing public works into collections and also allows adapting existing works within authorized limits. Creators can also upload HTML, or import works after organizing them according to Dong Le Ya's format via an external Agent. When publishing, they can set whether to allow downloading and adaptation. 平台支持将公开作品组织为合集，也允许在授权范围内改编已有作品。创作者还可上传 HTML，或通过外部 Agent 按懂了鸭的格式整理后导入作品，发布时可设置是否允许下载、改编。

The internal beta version offers both web and mini-program forms. The original text also showcased a referencable subject knowledge tree and model selection features to assist creation; these mechanisms do not guarantee the accuracy of the generated educational content. 内测版本提供网页与小程序两种形态。原文还展示了可引用的学科知识树和模型选择功能，用于辅助创作；这些机制并不代表生成的教育内容已经得到准确性保证。

item.title: ChatGPT 推出对话锁，支持 PIN 与生物识别解锁
item.guid: ChatGPT-推出对话锁，支持-PIN-与生物识别解锁
item.description:
ChatGPT is gradually rolling out the Locked Chats feature, allowing users to lock saved conversations and access them with a four-digit account PIN; supported mobile devices can also use Face ID, Touch ID, or device unlock methods. ChatGPT 开始逐步推出 Locked Chats 功能，用户可为保存的对话上锁，以四位账户 PIN 访问；支持的移动设备也可使用 Face ID、Touch ID 或设备解锁方式。

Once locked, conversations will be moved to "Projects > Locked chats" and hidden from regular history, pinned, and normal conversation searches. They will still be saved and can be reopened by the user; this differs from temporary conversations that do not enter history. 上锁后，对话会移至「Projects > Locked chats」，从常规历史、置顶和普通对话搜索中隐藏。它仍会保存，用户可再次打开；这与不会进入历史记录的临时对话不同。

OpenAI emphasizes that conversation locks do not create end-to-end encryption or separate encrypted vaults, nor do they change retention periods or the "improve model for everyone" setting. When memory is enabled, new messages after locking can be used for the memory of other locked conversations but will not update regular memory; information already remembered before locking will not be removed. OpenAI 强调，对话锁不会创建端到端加密或独立加密保险库，也不改变保留期限及「为所有人改进模型」设置。启用记忆时，上锁后的新消息可用于其他锁定对话的记忆，但不会更新常规记忆；上锁前已经记住的信息不会因此移除。

If you choose to reset after forgetting your PIN, locked conversations, related memories, and files protected by the old PIN will be permanently deleted. This feature covers Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu versions; the medical version is not yet supported. 忘记 PIN 后若选择重置，会永久删除受旧 PIN 保护的锁定对话、相关记忆与文件。该功能覆盖 Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 和 Edu，医疗版暂不支持。

item.title: MemT 1.0 开源，让模型在内部记忆中保留和调用经验
item.guid: MemT-1.0-开源，让模型在内部记忆中保留和调用经验
item.description:
Memory Tensor has released and open-sourced the MemT 1.0 series of memory-native foundation models, including Flash and Nano, with total parameters of 288B and 36B respectively, and active parameters of 17B and 3B respectively. Model weights and inference code are available via Hugging Face and GitHub. 记忆张量发布并开源记忆原生基础模型 MemT 1.0 系列，包含 Flash 和 Nano 两款模型，总参数分别为 288B、36B，激活参数分别为 17B、3B。模型权重与推理代码已通过 Hugging Face、GitHub 提供。

MemT 1.0 incorporates a native memory module into the Transformer, allowing memory attention to run in parallel with original attention. When generating a response, the model reads existing memories; after an interaction round, it writes the input and response into an independent dynamic memory state for subsequent tasks. During online interaction, the model backbone and hyper-memory weights remain fixed, while the memory state of each interaction trajectory changes. MemT 1.0 在 Transformer 中加入原生记忆模块，让记忆注意力与原有注意力并行运行。生成回答时，模型读取已有记忆；一轮交互结束后，再把输入与回答写入独立的动态记忆状态，供后续任务使用。在线交互期间，模型主干及超记忆权重保持固定，变化的是每条交互轨迹的记忆状态。

According to team evaluations, the two models scored an average of 50.6 and 47.0 respectively on 11 memory benchmarks, with no historical original text provided in the query context during testing; the ranking scope is parameterized memory methods evaluated this time, and text memory systems still have an overall advantage in long historical retrieval. 据团队评测，两款模型在 11 项记忆基准上平均得分分别为 50.6 和 47.0，测试时不在查询上下文中提供历史原文；排名范围为本次评估的参数化记忆方法，文本记忆系统在长历史检索上仍有整体优势。

The team also pointed out that fixed-capacity memory requires a trade-off between retaining early details and accepting new information. Current programming experience applications still rely on external experience libraries and retrieval, and a complete closed loop for autonomous acquisition, verification, and continuous integration of experience has not yet been formed. 团队也指出，固定容量记忆需要在保留早期细节与接纳新信息之间权衡，当前编程经验应用仍依赖外部经验库和检索，尚未形成自主获取、验证并持续整合经验的完整闭环。

item.title: 影翎 A1 更新：新增 4G 图传与绕行避障
item.guid: 影翎-A1-更新：新增-4G-图传与绕行避障
item.description:
Yingling AG released its A1 drone autumn update on October 20th, introducing a classic dual-joystick remote controller and a 4G image transmission enhancement module, and adding obstacle avoidance bypass and fixed-speed flight functions through a firmware upgrade. 影翎 AG 于 10 月 20 日发布 A1 无人机秋季更新，推出经典双摇杆遥控器与 4G 图传增强模块，并通过固件升级新增绕行避障和定速飞行功能。

The classic remote controller features a dual-joystick, button, and dial design, aimed at creators who require more precise control over flight trajectories and camera movements. When paired with Vision flight goggles, users can switch between fixed and free perspectives. 经典遥控器采用双摇杆、按键与拨轮设计，面向需要更精细控制飞行轨迹和镜头运动的创作者。配合 Vision 飞行眼镜，用户可以在固定视角与自由视角之间切换。

The 4G image transmission enhancement module has a built-in eSIM and can work in conjunction with OmniLink 360 native image transmission. The module is installed by default on the drone side, and a dedicated optional image transmission module is also available for the flight goggles side. 4G 图传增强模块内置 eSIM，可与 OmniLink 360 原生图传协同工作。模块默认安装于无人机端，飞行眼镜端也提供专属选装图传模块。

This firmware upgrade also added obstacle avoidance bypass and fixed-speed flight capabilities to the A1. Regarding pricing, the Yingling A1 Classic Remote Controller Set was originally priced at 8499 yuan, with a Double Eleven promotional price of 7299 yuan; the 4G Image Transmission Enhancement Module was originally priced at 699 yuan, with a limited-time promotional price of 559 yuan. 此次固件升级还为 A1 增加了绕行避障和定速飞行能力。售价方面，影翎 A1 经典遥控器套装原价 8499 元，双十一促销价为 7299 元；4G 图传增强模块原价 699 元，限时促销价为 559 元。

item.title: 元宝搜索通过腾讯云对外开放，支持 API、MCP 和 Skill 接入
item.guid: 元宝搜索通过腾讯云对外开放，支持-API、MCP-和-Skill-接入
item.description:
Tencent announced that Yuanbao Search officially opened to the public via Tencent Cloud on October 20th, providing internet search capabilities for large models and Agents. This service integrates public resources across the entire network and Tencent's content ecosystem, allowing developers to access it through API, MCP, and Skill. 腾讯宣布，元宝搜索 10 月 20 日正式通过腾讯云对外开放，面向大模型和 Agent 提供联网搜索能力。该服务整合全网公开资源与腾讯内容生态，开发者可通过 API、MCP 和 Skill 三种方式接入。

According to Tencent Cloud, Yuanbao Search has formed a trillion-level index, with daily call volumes reaching hundreds of millions, supporting over 50 Tencent businesses such as WorkBuddy, ima, Tencent FinTech, and Tencent Video. The service can understand colloquial queries, mixed-language usage, and name ambiguities, and sorts results based on relevance, timeliness, and authority. 据腾讯云介绍，元宝搜索已形成千亿级索引，日均调用量达数亿次，支撑 WorkBuddy、ima、腾讯金融科技、腾讯视频等 50 多个腾讯业务。服务可理解口语化查询、多语种混用及名称歧义，并依据相关性、时效性和权威性对结果排序。

Tencent Cloud product pages show that the service supports retrieval by specified URLs, time ranges, and vertical domains, and can return summaries, image lists, and relevance information. Content such as policies, news, weather, and market conditions supports minute-level updates; the official lists information denoising and direct use by models as the main directions for reducing subsequent processing costs. 腾讯云产品页显示，服务支持指定网址、时间范围与垂直领域检索，可返回摘要、图片列表及相关性信息。政策、新闻、天气和行情等内容支持分钟级更新；官方将信息去噪和供模型直接使用，列为降低后续处理成本的主要方向。

item.title: 麦当劳发布「薯标」
item.guid: 麦当劳发布「薯标」
item.description:
McDonald's China announced on October 20 that the "Recreate Goodness" fries-themed mouse set will be available for sale on the MaiMai Mall starting at 10:45 AM on October 22 and 23, with 2,000 sets limited each day. 麦当劳中国 10 月 20 日宣布，「重塑好物」薯条款鼠标套装将于 10 月 22、23 日 10:45 起在麦麦商城发售，每日各限量 2000 套。

The mouse in the official poster features a red fries box paired with golden fries, equipped with a red scroll wheel, and the set also includes a storage bag printed with a fries pattern. McDonald's states that this "fries mouse" is made from recycled old Happy Meal toys. 官方海报中的鼠标采用红色薯条盒搭配金黄色薯条的造型，配有红色滚轮，套装还展示了一只印有薯条图案的收纳包。麦当劳称，这款「薯标」由回收的开心乐园餐旧玩具再生制成。

This product comes from a collaboration between McDonald's China and Lenovo Group. An official press release in June introduced that old Happy Meal toys, after sorted recycling, enter Lenovo's green supply chain to complete disassembly, material regeneration, and professional processing, transforming into new materials usable for production. 这项产品来自麦当劳中国与联想集团的合作。今年 6 月的官方新闻稿介绍，开心乐园餐旧玩具经过分类回收后，进入联想绿色供应链，完成拆解、材料再生及专业加工，转化为可用于生产的新材料。

McDonald's launched the "Recreate Goodness" circular regeneration program in 2021, having previously introduced recycled products such as green dinner plates, eco-friendly charging bicycles, and Happy Planters. This announcement details the specific sales arrangements for the fries mouse set on the MaiMai Mall. 麦当劳于 2021 年启动「重塑好物」循环再生计划，此前已推出绿色餐盘、环保充电单车、开心花盆等再生产品。这次公布的是薯标套装在麦麦商城的具体发售安排。

item.title: lululemon 在上海联动场馆，推出 8 天「一起好状态」热汗课程
item.guid: lululemon-在上海联动场馆，推出-8-天「一起好状态」热汗课程
item.description:
lululemon launched its "Together in Good State" series of activities, collaborating with multiple venues in Shanghai to offer an 8-day themed sweat class, and initiating different types of exercise classes in stores nationwide. lululemon 开启「一起好状态」系列活动，在上海联合多家场馆推出为期 8 天的主题热汗课程，并在全国门店发起不同类型的运动课程。

The activities cover yoga, Pilates, strength training, and body recovery, including an all-around Tabata class led by brand ambassador MoMo.V. The brand hopes to bring classes into different sports spaces through collaborations with venues and community partners. 活动涵盖瑜伽、普拉提、力量训练和身体恢复，也包括品牌大使 MoMo.V 带来的全能 Tabata 课。品牌希望通过场馆与社区伙伴合作，将课程带进不同运动空间。

item.title: 宋佳、文淇主演《我们仅有一次的人生》定档 11 月 7 日
item.guid: 宋佳、文淇主演《我们仅有一次的人生》定档-11-月-7-日
item.description:
The film "Our Only Life" (original title "Embers") announced its release on November 7, along with a new poster and trailer. The film is written and directed by Sun Aoqian, starring Song Jia, Wen Qi, and Zu Feng. 电影《我们仅有一次的人生》（原名《余烬》）宣布将于 11 月 7 日上映，并发布定档海报和预告。影片由孙傲谦编剧、执导，宋佳、文淇、祖峰领衔主演。

The story revolves around Huang Yan and Yao Xue: Huang Yan, played by Song Jia, gradually loses her expectation for life in her daily cremation work. Due to an accident, she meets Yao Xue, who has just lost her mother, played by Wen Qi. The two lonely people gradually grow closer in winter, re-understanding each other and life. 故事围绕黄燕与姚雪展开：宋佳饰演的黄燕在日常火化工作中逐渐失去对生活的期待，因一场意外，与刚刚失去母亲的姚雪相遇，后者由文淇饰演。两个孤独的人在冬季逐渐靠近，重新理解彼此与生活。

item.title: 《戴帽子的猫》发布新预告，11 月 6 日内地、北美同步上映
item.guid: 《戴帽子的猫》发布新预告，11-月-6-日内地、北美同步上映
item.description:
Warner Bros. animated film "The Cat in the Hat" released a new trailer, announcing its simultaneous release in mainland China and North America on November 6. The film is adapted from Dr. Seuss's classic children's book. 华纳兄弟动画电影《戴帽子的猫》发布新预告，宣布将于 11 月 6 日在中国内地与北美同步上映。影片改编自苏斯博士的经典童书。

In the trailer, the cat with the red and white striped tall hat transforms the sofa into a vehicle and toys into adventure companions, dispelling children's worries with boundless imagination. The film is created by the team behind "The Minecraft Movie." 预告中，戴着红白条纹高帽的猫把沙发变成交通工具，让玩具成为冒险伙伴，以天马行空的想象为孩子驱散烦恼。影片由《我的世界大电影》幕后团队打造。

item.title: Carol Choi 将接任迪士尼亚太区总裁，12 月 1 日生效
item.guid: Carol-Choi-将接任迪士尼亚太区总裁，12-月-1-日生效
item.description:
Disney announced on October 20 that Carol Choi, current Executive Vice President for Asia Pacific, will succeed Luke Kang as President for Asia Pacific on December 1. Kang has decided to retire, ending his tenure at Disney. 迪士尼 10 月 20 日宣布，现任亚太区执行副总裁 Carol Choi 将于 12 月 1 日接任亚太区总裁。现任总裁 Luke Kang 决定退休，结束在迪士尼的任职。

According to company statements published by Deadline and The Hollywood Reporter, Choi will be responsible for Disney Entertainment's businesses in Greater China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, covering film business, Disney+, local original content production, consumer products, media networks, and content sales. 据 Deadline 与 The Hollywood Reporter 刊出的公司声明，Choi 将负责迪士尼娱乐在大中华区、日本、韩国、东南亚、澳大利亚和新西兰的业务，范围涵盖电影业务、Disney+、本地原创内容制作、消费品、媒体网络及内容销售。

Choi joined Disney in 2006, having previously been responsible for operations in Japan and Korea, and also held management positions in Greater China. She currently oversees the Asia Pacific film business, original content strategy, and integrated marketing, and was involved in the launch and expansion of Disney+ in the region. Choi 于 2006 年加入迪士尼，曾负责日本和韩国业务，也曾在大中华区担任管理职务。她目前主管亚太区电影业务、原创内容策略及整合营销，并参与了 Disney+ 在该地区的推出与扩展。
